subject.title: Feature: Add maxTurns/maxToolCalls config option to limit agent iterations

question: Should OpenClaw accept the public iteration-budget contract proposed by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97485, including config names, budget unit, exhaustion result, and unsupported-harness fail-closed behavior?
rationale: The missing capability is real, but adding strict agent config and harness/runtime semantics is a public compatibility contract that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve the PR contract
options.body: Confirm the opt-in iterationBudget keys, pre-tool-round enforcement, and fail-closed harness behavior so the active PR can proceed through merge review.

options.title: Revise before release
options.body: Ask the PR to rename or narrow the config fields, budget unit, or exhaustion behavior before merge so the first shipped contract is the intended one.

options.title: Pause the core feature
options.body: Keep this issue open for design while closing or pausing the active PR if maintainers do not want a core hard-budget surface yet.

recommendation.title: Approve the PR contract
recommendation.body: Confirm the opt-in iterationBudget keys, pre-tool-round enforcement, and fail-closed harness behavior so the active PR can proceed through merge review.
